Author: Looneth
Name: Bagcheck
Punchline: A shopping list and retainer tracker for crafters.
Description: Know what you need, what you have, and where it's cheapest. Bagcheck keeps count; you do the shopping.
Changelog: First release: a shopping list with Teamcraft import, holdings across bags, crystals, saddlebag and retainers, data-centre prices with NPC vendors and a total, and a Retainers tab.

Author: Looneth
Name: RePlate
Punchline: Save and restore your adventurer plate.
Description: Save your adventurer plate and your gear sets' portraits, and put them back whenever you like. Share them as codes, too.
Changelog: Undo last restore puts back the plate you had before a restore, and pressing it again redoes. Settings also has a new Dark window style that makes RePlate look like the game's own windows, in the game's fonts.
